messages.text:
Yes. The shop's records show the blue mug was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The order is also within the refund window (refund-policy/v2/window).

The refund proposal is 49.90 BRL, which is what you paid for the mug (refund-policy/v2/amount). Shipping isn't included.

To confirm, press the button on the proposal card. Typing "yes" in the chat won't confirm it. A staff member then reviews the request (refund-policy/v2/approval). I'll tell you once there's a decision.
